name: Seek advice for personal and social dilemmas
description: Users sought advice or validation on how to navigate complex interpersonal conflicts, family dynamics, and specific ethical or social dilemmas, often involving authority figures, relatives, or sensitive situations. The requests frequently focused on determining appropriate actions, such as what to say or do in high-stakes scenarios, or evaluated the acceptability of specific responses to the behavior of others.
